scope: Independent read-only review of event-gated late-client drain acceptance and two real UDP gate unit tests

checks.subject: Real handshake
checks.result: The gate captures a datagram emitted by the actual next_client C, delays forwarding until the observed server DRAIN_BEGIN, and thereafter relays client and server bytes without constructing protocol responses.

checks.subject: Drain deadline and assertions
checks.result: The server retains --drain-after-ms 2000 and --drain-timeout-ms 200. The complete valid boolean expression is AST-identical to HEAD, including exact A/B/C return codes, one timeout, one acknowledgment, one nonfatal reason-8 server/client rejection, and acknowledged=1/forced=1/resumed=1.

checks.subject: Endpoint filtering and packet handling
checks.result: The socket binds loopback with an ephemeral port, learns the first client address, forwards only that client and the configured exact server endpoint, and retains one pre-release datagram for the current single ENet connect attempt. Forwarding errors fail acceptance. ConnectionResetError records closed-endpoint ICMP while all required application events remain mandatory.

checks.subject: Thread synchronization
checks.result: Pending packet, release state and endpoints use one lock, with ready/stopping Events for cross-thread coordination. Server stdout has one reader during normal collection, both output threads are joined after process exit, and the gate receive uses a 50ms timeout with bounded join.

checks.subject: Owned process cleanup
checks.result: The finally path closes the owned gate and terminates each still-running owned child, escalating to kill after a 3-second communicate timeout. No external process is selected.

verification_boundary: This review independently ran the two UDP gate tests and read the existing full-runtime reports. It did not rerun the reported stress campaign or execute another full runtime build.
